thread:
Alex K: starting thread for Acme Health POC — we need to lock hosting mode + success criteria. customer wants PHI-aware summarization + retrieval + short-form answers for clinicians. timeline goal: 3 week POC (week1: integration + evals, week2: perf tuning, week3: scale tests).

Ming Zhao: quick q — do they require BYOK / HSM for keys? that will force Private most likely.

Alex K: good call. sales said security questionnaire flagged KMS + data residency. proposal: run initial functional eval on Hosted (quicker onboarding), then run a short Dedicated run for throughput tests. Private only if they sign contract for KMS or on-prem audit.

Sarah P: pricing sanity check — what ballpark for 2-GPU dedicated for 1 month of POC? we just need a rough number for the SOW.

Jordan L: rough guidance — dedicated estimate will depend on GPU class and commit. I can draft a ballpark and include burst credit options. also note — EU region adds a bit of premium for reserved capacity.

Talia (Security): from security: they'll need SOC2 evidence, SAML SSO + SCIM, KMS integration (BYOK) and audit logs export to their SIEM. Hosted supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration but HSM-backed BYOK is Private-only. also we need to run our questionnaire responses through their vendor security team.

Alex K: ok, so decision criteria matrix I'm thinking:
- Must-have: data residency (EU), BYOK/HSM, SSO, audit logs
- Nice-to-have: dedicated throughput SLA, lower per-token unit cost
- Success metrics for POC: 1) accuracy: >= 85% on curated 100 clinical eval prompts, 2) p50 latency < 200ms for short responses, p95 < 500ms under 100 rps load, 3) cost goal: <= $0.03/token-unit (TBD units), 4) retrieval correctness: top-1 recall >= 90% on test set.

Ming Zhao: adding eval details — we'll run 100 prompts + 50 adversarial PHI edge cases. example prompt in eval harness:
```
You are a clinical assistant. Summarize the following note, redacting PHI and returning a 3-sentence summary with source citations.
Note: [FULL_NOTE_HERE]
```
Results will be measured as: ROUGE-L + manual audit for PHI redaction.

Presales Bot: POC runbook template: https://redwood.internal/presales/poc-runbook (use checklist: onboarding creds, model pin, route policies, metrics dashboard). :page_facing_up:  

Sarah P: for the SOW I'll draft two options: (A) Hosted-first (2 weeks hosted + 1 week dedicated smoke), (B) Private option (longer lead, requires PO + infra checklist). which should I price first?

Jordan L: price A first (faster close). list out conversion point for Private (if they require HSM/BYOK or contractual data residency that Hosted can't meet).

Talia (Security): requesting that sales push the customer's vendor security questionnaire ASAP. we'll fill standard responses but any custom legal asks will push timeline. also will need an NDA + DPA in place before exchanging PHI test data.

Alex K: action items: @Sarah P draft SOW A with Hosted-first pricing + Dedicated smoke quote by EOD tomorrow; @Jordan L prepare EU dedicated premium + rough estimate; @Talia (Security) start vendor questionnaire answers and flag HSM reqs; @Ming Zhao create eval harness and upload 100 prompts. I'll coordinate kickoff call.

Ming Zhao: noted — I'll upload eval set to the runbook and share results channel with CI badges.

Sarah P: thanks — I'll ping legal on DPA and add a clause for data residency.

Alex K: :) good. if anyone sees blockers (e.g., timeline slip for Private onboarding), call it out here. otherwise we'll proceed with Hosted-first plan.

Jordan L: small note — if we run dedicated smoke, enable KV prefix caching and set batching to 16 to hit throughput targets. I'll add recommended runtime config in the runbook.

Talia (Security): also request that customer supplies a list of sample data (anonymized) for the redaction test. we can't accept PHI until DPA is signed.

Alex K: perfect — wrapping. next sync after SOW draft. :thumbsup:
